Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

colvR 0.2.0

Breaking changes

  • Predictions.marginales() has been removed: use Predictions(type = "marginal").
  • select_model_bic() now returns a list with the criterion values, the selected latent dimension (q_star) and the corresponding fit (fit_star), instead of a vector of BIC values.
  • In Miss.PLNPCA(), q is now the third argument, as in Miss.ZIPLNPCA().
  • The example dataset fuligule_milouin has been replaced by waterbird, with anonymized sites and years and without the latitude covariate.

New features

  • Predictions() gains the arguments type (conditional or marginal intervals), probs (quantile levels), output (draws, latent variables and parameter draws in addition to the intervals), cl (parallel VE steps) and verbose.
  • New function ICL(), the Integrated Completed Likelihood.
  • select_model_bic() gains the arguments criterion (BIC or ICL) and model.
  • BIC() gains the argument model ("ZIPLNPCA" or "PLNPCA").

Bug fixes

  • BIC() now counts 2d regression parameters for the ZIP-PLN-PCA model, and d or pd for the PLN-PCA model, depending on the design.
  • select_model_bic() now works with non-contiguous values of latents.
  • In the Miss.ZIPLNPCA*() functions, pred$predicted is now the ZIP expectation xi * A, consistent with imputed.
  • Predictions() no longer fails when q = 1.

Other changes

  • All examples are now runnable, on small simulated data.
  • New unit tests for the selection criteria, select_model_bic(), Predictions() and Miss.ZIPLNPCA().
  • All messages are now in English.

colvR 0.2.1

Changes

  • Explanation of acronyms
  • Removal of console output from Miss.ZIPLNPCA_Steps()
